premises.text: Startups and mid-sized firms lose campus recruiting contests against big spenders despite student talent's high ROI
premises.evidence_span: college recruiting has been growing about 15% a year, and big companies are spending a lot of money on campus

premises.text: Personal relationships tip student offer decisions even against better-known employers
premises.evidence_span: relationships are the key to hiring great students

premises.text: LinkedIn-style referral recruiting fails for college because students lack workforce networks
premises.evidence_span: traditional recruiting services don't work well for college recruiting

premises.text: Meritful's company portal and ambassadors invite students met at fairs/info sessions into multi-year relationship workflows
premises.evidence_span: it gets a private company portal and invites a few of its employees to join as company ambassadors

premises.text: Challenges, project showcases, and progress insights let companies identify fit and students get expert feedback
premises.evidence_span: companies can create challenges for students to work on

premises.text: Always free for students; companies pay a monthly subscription
premises.evidence_span: Meriful is always free for students and is available at a monthly subscription to companies

value.text: Companies hire talented students by sustaining recruiting relationships beyond one campus visit
value.evidence_span: build a sustainable relationship with students that's directly tied to their recruiting efforts
